content: High-intensity statin therapy is defined as treatment that reduces low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) levels by 50% or more. This category includes the following specific medications and dosages: Atorvastatin administered at a dosage of 40 to 80 milligrams per day. Rosuvastatin administered at a dosage of 20 to 40 milligrams per day. These regimens are recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) for achieving significant LDL-C reduction.
